Text: WHEN the POS sends a completed purchase event, the loyalty service shall create a pending points transaction for the member.
The loyalty service shall award 1 point per SGD 1 of the purchase amount, rounded down per transaction.
Rationale: Earning rule in the programme terms.

Text: WHEN a pending points transaction is 24 hours old and the purchase was not returned, the loyalty service shall post the points to the member's balance.
Rationale: The 24-hour return window protects against points on returned goods.

Text: WHEN the loyalty service posts points for a purchase, the updated balance shall be available to the customer mobile app within TBD seconds.
Rationale: "Quickly" in LOY-118 needs a measurable target; open question Q1 to SH-01.

Text: WHEN the cashier scans a voucher at the POS, the POS shall apply the voucher value as a discount to the open sale.
Rationale: The POS applies the discount; it is outside the system boundary.

Text: WHEN a support agent submits an adjustment above 5,000 points, the admin console shall require approval by a second support agent before posting it.
The customer mobile app shall be intuitive.
Rationale: Members should redeem without calling support.

Text: WHILE the year-end sale peak is running, the loyalty service shall accept TBD purchase events per minute without losing an event.
Rationale: Last year's peak was about 9,000 purchases per minute across stores.

Text: The loyalty service shall be available TBD % of each calendar month.
Rationale: The POS and the app depend on it during opening hours.

Text: The loyalty service shall retain points transaction records for 7 years after the transaction date.
The loyalty service shall not store payment card numbers.
Rationale: Keeps the service out of PCI DSS scope.
